comparison.objective: Align a robot elbow’s zero marks while inserting and releasing a mastering pin; candidate commissions a robot-axis shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual joint support, visual alignment, and pin insertion versus counterholding, hex-key insertion, collar tuning, torque-limited locking, and cycle testing.
comparison.success_condition: Marks aligned, pin home, green indication, and joint retained after release versus two non-bottoming stops with no excessive rebound or drift. No separate specs or alignment tolerances are provided.
comparison.reason: Both concern robot maintenance and alignment, but mastering establishes joint datum through pin insertion; the candidate tunes and verifies dynamic energy absorption.
